attributes.action: All women of menstruation age should have free access to basic Sanitary products
attributes.background:
All menstruating women should have free access to basic Sanitary products as menstruation is not a choice. 
50% of the population will spend approx half their life dealing with menstruation which, at a time of high cost of living, is an unfair expense which many women cannot afford.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Provide funding so all shops can offer free period products" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/778900
